The shaping_reward (progress-delta) and vertical_speed_penalty near ground are not strong enough to push the policy to actually land. Additionally, add a small positive reward for being near the pad (|x|<0.1, y<0.2) with both legs contacting, even if not fully stable, to bridge the gap between near-success and true success. This should increase the success rate without introducing farming.
